title: Cosmonaut fooled crewmate with ice particles as 'UFO fleet'

tellings.quote: one of them told this story that he

plain: A cosmonaut is said to have played a joke in a space capsule by telling a crewmate that bits of ice drifting outside were a fleet of UFOs. The Swedish UFO researcher Clas Svahn tells Michels that one of the cosmonauts told this story himself, and he offers it as a case where something seen in space turned out to be ordinary.
